recipe.visualDefinition: A soft-focus, medium close-up portrait of a woman in a rural field, holding a single crimson clover flower. The image features a warm, analog film aesthetic with visible grain and a muted, naturalistic color palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a soft-focus green meadow background
The red clover acts as a vibrant focal point against neutral skin tones
Wavy, organic typography positioned at the top center, echoing the natural curves of the hair
Soft, diffused daylight creating gentle shadows on the face
coreInvariants: Direct eye contact with a neutral expression

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium close-up; head and shoulders occupy the middle vertical third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The crimson clover flower held in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the flower up to the subject's eyes, then to the title text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample blurred green space in the upper corners and sides.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sage and olive greens in the background meadow.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm beige and tan tones in the subject's skin and knitwear.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crimson red of the clover flower.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a matte finish; values are compressed to avoid harsh blacks or whites.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight, high-contrast serif with fluid, liquid-like distortions.
letterConstructionRules: Wavy, undulating baselines and cap heights
Thick vertical strokes with thin, curved horizontal connectors
Softened, rounded corners on all serifs
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'E' has a fluid, wave-like middle bar
The 'L' has a curved, drooping foot
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stand-alone display type; no secondary fonts.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the organic, liquid movement of the lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 35mm film photograph of a woman with long brown hair in a green meadow, holding a red clover flower. Use soft natural light, visible grain, and a muted color palette. The background should be a soft-focus field and trees.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of custom wavy, liquid-style bold serif text in cream color at the top center. The text should have an organic, hand-drawn feel with undulating baselines.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain visible and natural?
Does the text have a liquid, wavy distortion?
Is the red clover the only high-saturation element?
Is the overall mood soft and pastoral?

adjustableVariables: Degree of wave distortion in the text
Depth of field in the background
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for authentic-looking film grain rather than digital noise.
Ensure the text color is off-white/cream, not pure #FFFFFF.
Verify the clover flower looks like a Trifolium pratense (red clover).
Confirm the subject's expression remains neutral and soft.
recipe.reuseFormula: Analog Portrait + Pastoral Setting + Liquid Serif Typography + Muted Earth Tones
